checked_classes: Spec violations — the diff records the deliberate default-include policy and adds discovery, publication, watcher, .compassignore, extra-exclude, and saved-scope regression coverage required by the acceptance criteria.

Correctness — the test fixtures exercise both a Rust workspace member and Go source beneath vendor/, and assertions check inventory, published source anchors, discovery results, and watcher filtering consistently.

Regressions — the packet explicitly defines this as preservation of existing behavior, and the added tests pin both default eligibility and all specified opt-out surfaces without changing production code.
Security — the diff adds only local temporary-fixture tests and documentation; it introduces no network, credential, deserialization, subprocess, or path-containment boundary.

Constraint breaches — the diff uses deterministic BTreeMap collection, typed Result propagation, temporary directories, locked verification commands, and includes the required lowest-layer plus build-level regression coverage.
Silent failure — test setup and graph building propagate errors, while policy outcomes are asserted directly rather than converted to defaults or empty-success states.
